items.title: TypeScript compiles to native binaries
items.oneliner: Compile TypeScript into small native binaries with no JavaScript engine and near-Node behavior for CLI and edge tools.

items.title: Postgres internals become interactive
items.oneliner: Interactive simulator shows how WAL, locks, checkpoints, and vacuum affect PostgreSQL performance under changing workloads.

items.title: Parquet gets faster vector decoding
items.oneliner: Deep dive and benchmarks show fixed-length list decoding up to 3.7x faster for embeddings and columnar analytics.

items.title: SQLite WAL locking gotcha explained
items.oneliner: Reproducible Python example shows why WAL mode can lock read-only processes and when DELETE mode works better.

items.title: Build a lock-free queue
items.oneliner: Step-by-step C++ walkthrough implements a lock-free queue with atomics, memory ordering, and ABA tradeoffs explained.

items.title: Build a self-setting clock
items.oneliner: Full DIY guide covers hardware, software, and 3D printing for a bedside clock that survives outages and DST.

items.title: HyperCard-style multimedia ships today
items.oneliner: Create interactive documents, games, and zines with a lightweight scripting language and export them as standalone HTML.

items.title: Loading states get better defaults
items.oneliner: Open-source CSS and React loaders give you accessible spinners and skeletons you can drop into production today.

items.title: VLC now powers Unity on Linux
items.oneliner: Open-source Unity plugin brings VLC media playback to Linux builds for apps that need robust video support.

items.title: Cassette audio simulation is scriptable
items.oneliner: FFmpeg scripts recreate tape noise, wow, flutter, and EQ so you can batch-process audio into vintage profiles.
